projects.name: Richardson, Texas land parcel adjacent to existing campus
projects.quote: As previously disclosed, during the quarter, Digital Realty closed on the acquisition of a 6.7-acre parcel in Richardson, Texas, adjacent to its existing campus, for approximately $15 million, which can support the development of up to 100 megawatts of incremental IT capacity.
